title: Handling device, especially vaccum handling device

features.item: A housing with a grip portion for gripping and an electrically operated vacuum generating device
features.quote: The invention relates to a vacuum handling device with a suction box ( 12 ), a vacuum blower ( 22 ), a handling device ( 16 ) and a suction unit ( 20 )
features.note: The reference discloses a vacuum handling device with a handling device (grip portion) and a vacuum blower (electrically operated vacuum generating device).
features.refuted: The quote describes a vacuum handling device with separate components (suction box, vacuum blower, handling device, suction unit) but does not mention a housing with a grip portion for gripping.

features.item: The grip portion is a hollow body
features.note: The reference does not explicitly state that the handling device (grip portion) is a hollow body.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device is guided through the grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe the path of exhaust air from the vacuum generating device through the grip portion.

features.item: A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention a sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip portion
features.quote: The invention relates to a vacuum handling device with a suction box ( 12 ), a vacuum blower ( 22 ), a handling device ( 16 ) and a suction unit ( 20 )
features.note: The reference discloses a handling device (grip unit) with an electrically operated vacuum generator, but does not specify a hollow grip portion, exhaust air routed through the grip, or a sound-damping device in the grip portion.

features.item: A vacuum handling apparatus comprising a suction plate with carrier plate and seal, and a grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device
features.quote: The invention relates to a vacuum handling device with a suction box ( 12 ), a vacuum blower ( 22 ), a handling device ( 16 ) and a suction unit ( 20 ) obturating the suction box and consisting
features.note: The reference discloses a vacuum handling device with a suction plate and a suction pad (seal), and a grip unit with an electrically operated vacuum generator. However, it does not specify a hollow grip portion, exhaust air routed through the grip, or a sound-damping device in the grip portion.

features.item: The grip portion is at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not mention the grip portion being lined with sound-damping material.

features.item: The vacuum generating device is arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.quote: Several vacuum blowers 22 are provided under the hood 14 , with which a vacuum is created in the suction box 12 .
features.note: The reference states that vacuum blowers are provided under a hood, which can be considered a housing portion. However, it does not explicitly state that the vacuum generating device is *completely* arranged in a *first* housing portion, implying a multi-part housing structure.

features.item: A sound-reducing device is arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not mention a sound-reducing device or lining in any housing portion.

features.item: The grip portion is elongated between the first housing portion and a second housing portion, with air outlet on the second housing portion
features.note: The reference does not describe the grip portion being elongated between two housing portions with an air outlet on the second portion.

features.item: An air collection screw arranged upstream of the grip portion in the first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not mention an air collection screw or any specific mechanism for collecting exhaust air upstream of the grip portion.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of the grip portion for guiding exhaust air to the air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe bent or curved air baffles for guiding exhaust air.

features.item: A battery coupling point on the second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from the battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not mention a battery coupling point or air baffles directing exhaust air away from it.

features.item: The grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device
features.quote: A clamping device 38 , which has a clamping strip 40 around which a formed rubber 42 is placed, is employed to attach the suction unit 20 .
features.note: The reference discloses a clamping device to attach the suction unit (which includes the suction plate) to the suction box. While this is a connection, it's not explicitly stated as a releasable connection between a 'grip unit' and 'suction plate' as distinct components in the way the feature implies modularity.

features.item: The grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate
features.quote: The suction unit 20 covers one suction opening 34 of the suction box 12 and closes off this suction opening 34 , so that a vacuum can be created inside the suction box 12 .
features.note: The reference describes the suction unit (which includes the suction plate) covering a suction opening of the suction box (which is connected to the vacuum blower/grip unit), creating a vacuum inside the suction box, which functions as a suction chamber.
features.refuted: The quote describes a suction unit covering a suction opening of a suction box, but does not mention a grip unit or a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate.

claims.note: The reference describes a vacuum handling device but does not specify a 'grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device' or its use with a suction plate in the context of a grip unit.

claims.quote: The vacuum handling device 10 is also placed on top of the workpieces to be handled (not shown) with the handling device 16 , that is, the device 10 is positioned. Pickup and release of the workpieces is carried out
claims.note: The reference discloses a handling device (16) and vacuum blowers (22) which are electrically operated, but it does not explicitly describe a 'grip portion' as part of a housing for gripping the unit.
The reference does not describe the grip portion as being a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through the grip portion to an air outlet, nor does it mention a sound-damping device in the grip portion.
This reference does not disclose a sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion of a handling device. The reference focuses on vacuum handling devices and their suction units.
This reference does not disclose a grip portion being at least partially lined with a sound-damping material. The reference does not discuss sound damping in any part of the handling device.

This reference does not disclose a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion of the housing. While it mentions vacuum blowers and a handling device, it does not specify the arrangement within a housing portion or the concept of a 'first housing portion'.

This reference does not disclose a sound-reducing device arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion being lined with sound-reducing material. The reference does not mention sound reduction.

This reference describes a vacuum handling device with a suction box, vacuum blower, and suction unit, but does not mention a grip unit with an elongated grip portion between first and second housing portions, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.

This reference describes a vacuum handling device, but does not disclose an air collection device in the form of an air collection screw arranged upstream of a grip portion in a first housing portion for collecting exhaust air.
This reference describes a vacuum handling device, but does not disclose a grip portion or bent/curved air baffles arranged downstream of a grip portion for guiding exhaust air to an air outlet.

This reference describes a vacuum handling device, but does not disclose a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery on a housing, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a point.
The reference describes a vacuum handling device but does not mention air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.
